# Claude Code Models and API

A model is the Claude version that answers you.
Effort is how hard the model thinks before it answers, and an API call is one request to the model server.
You can change the model, the effort, and the retry rules.

## Example

Run `claude --model opus --effort high` for one hard task.
Or run `export CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES=3` to make a script fail sooner.
The marks in the tables are explained on [Claude Code](Claude-Code#marks).

## Choosing the Model

Source: [Model Configuration](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config) and [Hooks Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks).

| Item | Mark | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--model <model>` | ✅ | Sets the model of the session to an alias or a full name (see [CLI](Claude-Code-CLI)). |
| `ANTHROPIC_MODEL` | ✅ | Sets the model with the same values as `--model`. |
| `/model` | ✅ | Switches the model in a session and saves the choice in your user settings. |
| `model`, `modelSettings`, `availableModels`, `fallbackModel` | ✅ | Settings for the model, options for each model, an allowlist, and a fallback chain (see [Settings](Claude-Code-Settings)). |
| `default` | ✅ | Clears the override, and then the model is Opus 5.5 on the Anthropic API, on the paid plans, and on AWS and Google Cloud. |
| `opusplan` | ✅ | Uses `opus` in plan mode and `sonnet` when it runs the plan. |
| `best` | ✅ | Uses the `fable` model where you have it, and `opus` otherwise. |
| `[1m]` suffix | ✅ | Asks for the 1M window, as in `sonnet[1m]`, and does nothing on a model that has it already. |
| `--include-unsupported-models` | 🔍 | Offers models that your account can use and that this version does not know. |
| `PreModelSwitch` and `PostModelSwitch` hooks | ✅ | Run around a switch, and `PreModelSwitch` can block it. |

A switch of the model is a cache miss (see [Request Build](Claude-Code-Request-Build)).
The aliases and the provider names are on [Models Providers](Claude-Code-Models-Providers).

## Effort

The effort levels are `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, and `max`.
A level that the model does not accept runs as the highest accepted level below it.
Source: [Model Configuration](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config).

| Item | Mark | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--effort <level>` | ✅ | Sets the effort of a session, and `ultracode` sets `xhigh` and turns on the workflow mode. |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL` | ✅ | Sets the effort and wins over `--effort`, `/effort`, and the settings. `auto` uses the default of the model. |
| `effortLevel`, `modelSettings`, `maxEffortLevel` | ✅ | Settings for the default level and for a cap. |
| `output_config.effort` | ✅ | The request field that carries the level. |
| `per-turn-control-2026-07-01` | 🔍 | A beta that lets some models take the effort with each message. |
| `ultrathink` | ✅ | A word in a prompt that asks for deeper thinking on that turn only. |
| Default effort | ✅ | `high`, except `medium` for Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, and Haiku 5.5, and `xhigh` for Opus 4.7. |

## Thinking

Source: [Model Configuration](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config) and [Environment Variables](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/env-vars).

| Item | Mark | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `thinking: {type: "adaptive"}` | ✅ | Lets the model choose how long it thinks, and newer models always use it. |
| `--thinking <enabled\|adaptive\|disabled>` | 🔍 | A hidden flag for print mode, where `enabled` means the same as `adaptive`. |
| `--thinking-display <summarized\|omitted\|highlights>` | 🔍 | A hidden flag that sets how the thinking text comes back. |
| `--max-thinking-tokens` | 🔍 | A hidden flag that is deprecated. Use `--thinking` instead. |
| `MAX_THINKING_TOKENS` | ✅ | Sets a fixed thinking budget, and `0` turns thinking off on the Anthropic API. |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ADAPTIVE_THINKING` | ✅ | Goes back to the fixed budget on Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6. |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_THINKING` | ✅ | Leaves out the `thinking` field, for proxies that reject it. |
| `alwaysThinkingEnabled`, `showThinkingSummaries` | ✅ | Settings for thinking, and `Option+T` or `Alt+T` toggles it in a session. |

`MAX_THINKING_TOKENS` cannot turn thinking off on Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5, and the Fable models.
`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ADAPTIVE_THINKING` has no effect on newer models.

## Fallback

- A fallback chain (`--fallback-model`, `fallbackModel`) holds at most three models.
  It covers overload and server errors, and not auth, billing, rate-limit, request-size, or transport errors.
  The switch lasts for the current turn, and the next turn tries the main model first.
  Source: [Model Configuration](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config#fallback-model-chains).
- Content-based fallback applies to the Fable models, Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, and Opus 5.
  A request that is flagged as biology or cybersecurity runs again on the fallback model of that category.
  The session then stays on that model.
  Source: [Model Configuration](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config#automatic-model-fallback).
- `CLAUDE_CODE_NO_MODEL_FALLBACK` forbids the substitution of a model (🔍, a message in the bundle names it).

## Retries and Timeouts

Source: [Error Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/errors#automatic-retries) and [Environment Variables](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/env-vars).

| Item | Mark | Default | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES` | ✅ | 10 | Sets how many times a failed request is tried again, up to 15. |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG` | ✅ | Off | Retries `429` and `529` errors without end and removes the cap. |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_OVERLOADED_RETRY_BASE_DELAY_MS` | ✅ | 500 | Sets the start of the wait after a `529` error. |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_OVERLOADED_RETRY_MAX_DELAY_MS` | ✅ | 32000 | Sets the longest wait after a `529` error. |
| `API_TIMEOUT_MS` | ✅ | 600000 | Sets the timeout of a request. |
| `CLAUDE_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS` | ✅ | Set by the program | Closes a stream that is silent, and a value below 5 minutes counts as 5 minutes. |
| `CLAUDE_STREAM_FIRST_BYTE_TIMEOUT_MS` | ✅ | Set by the program | Sets the deadline for the first byte of a stream. |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONSTREAMING_FALLBACK` | ✅ | Off | Stops the retry without streaming after a stream fails. |

When a request is too long for the context, Claude Code tries again with a smaller `max_tokens`, and it compacts when that is not enough.
The loop also recovers from a stop at `max_tokens` and from a bad tool call (see [Turn Pipeline](Claude-Code-Turn-Pipeline)).
